bases.validation: Both complete945-tensor schemas match full meta models without exclusions. Headers only, not full contents or convergence.

adaptations: Native platform reader, trainer, loss counting, relative optimizer groups, strict safetensors loader and checkpoint assets; no LeRobot runtime
Preserve full released24-layer hybrid Qwen3.5 and24-layer full-attention action expert, original head/KV geometry, temporal vision and tied vocabulary projection
Official LIBERO flow recipe: FP32 trainable/master parameters, BF16 AMP, author FP32 islands, lr1e-5,100k steps,batch8,1000 warmup,8 flow draws,no EMA; checkpointing optional off by default

Respect fm.joint_training: flow gradients cross the cached VLM bridge only when true. LeRobot PR4445 deliberately fixes knowledge insulation to the base/SO101 default and explicitly documents its LIBERO/RoboTwin training difference; native integration retains the original configurable switch
Exact extended tokenizer size from idempotent token registration, local-only assets; retain action codes/markers/EOV/state ordering and original prompt serialization
Ordinary mlp proprio encoder has no dropout; mlp_dropout derives its0.2 or configured probability from source config. Proprio variants bin/null/zeros are not silently substituted
Explicit camera order/sizes and all selected views; uint8 bilinear resize before float normalization. Multi-frame visual memory uses actual temporal checkpoint geometry

Named recorded/transformed coordinates replace benchmark-specific guessed left/right layouts; fresh robot input/output/proprio heads by default; retaining them or ActionCodec requires explicit named slots
Native horizon counts future targets only; historical observations are separate. Multi-frame source configurations whose action horizon includes past context are not benchmark-equivalent
Train-only exact per-offset action normalization excludes virtual episode padding; generic window statistics and whole-chunk inverse normalization precede execution queues

Recorded robot preset q01/q99 preserves valid outliers; g05 clipping protocol adds original normalized[-5,5] bounds. Explicit normalization_mapping can select original mean/std protocol; no guessed gripper inversion/relative-pose conversion

Optional frozen FP32 ActionCodec supports independent CE and flow training; only requested inference head executes. Text and weighted-coordinate losses have separate global denominators for accumulation/validation
Frame-aligned generic annotation renderer shared with FineART; optional source Subtask/BBox CoT templates. No generated labels used as training truth

Optional non-reentrant whole-VLM/expert recomputation creates fresh mutable caches. Reference PyTorch GatedDelta and convolution paths validated; installed fused kernel alternatives, compile, LoRA, RTC and distributed execution unvalidated
